scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.python:dev: cd backend/python && if not exist venv (python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt) && venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8000
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run python:dev"
